title: Cost cutting and extra feature pricing
summary: Reviews on this topic center on value for money versus complaints about cost-cutting decisions and paying extra for expected features, with many sampled fragments too incomplete to classify clearly.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car's cost performance and overall value.

negative.summary: Negative reviews object to extra features costing more than expected.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly mention cost cutting, missing low-cost items, keys, climate controls, or add-on pricing, but the sample often lacks enough context to confirm a clear sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are assigned undetermined sentiment, so the topic has limited clearly classifiable evidence.
Some examples are very short or truncated, which reduces confidence about the exact aspect being judged.
The topic mixes related but distinct issues such as overall value, cost-cutting choices, missing included items, and optional extras costing more.
